sn12.48:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Atha kho lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā || pe|| || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn12.48:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sabbam atthīti || || Sabbam atthīti kho brāhmaṇa jeṭṭham etam lokāyatam || ||
sn12.48:3.1: Kim pana bho Gotama sabbaṃ natthīti || || Sabbaṃ natthīti kho brāhmaṇa dutiyaṃ etaṃ lokāyataṃ || ||
sn12.48:4.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sabbam ekattan ti || Sabbam ekattanti kho brāhmaṇa tatiyam etaṃ lokāyataṃ || ||
sn12.48:5.1: Kiṃ pana bho Gotama sabbaṃ puthuttanti || || Sabbaṃ puthuttanti kho brāhmaṇa catuttham etaṃ lokāyatam || ||
sn12.48:6.1: Ete te brāhmaṇa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || || Avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā || saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ || pe || || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī || || Avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho || saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho || pe|| || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
sn12.48:7.1: Evaṃ vutte lokāyatiko brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama || pe || ajjatagge pānupe taṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti || || Aṭṭhamaṃ || ||
